title: Cheesy Marinara Polenta Bake with Veggie Sausage & Lemony Asparagus

steps.text: Slice polenta crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Arrange slices in the bottom of a large baking dish, overlapping slightly. Pour marinara sauce over top, then sprinkle with cheese.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until polenta is warmed through and cheese is bubbly, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon over top of asparagus; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Add baking sheet to the oven and roast until asparagus is starting to soften, about 8 minutes.
When the asparagus is soft, remove from the oven and toss. Add sausages to the baking sheet and drizzle with additional oil.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until asparagus is tender and sausages are warmed through, 5-7 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide sausages, asparagus, and polenta bake between plates. Enjoy!
